=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:543-1051 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The required job `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` (failed check run 130844748366, run 43116204712, head 12a3174ff53afedbd9c8bcfcad5c3ff51c0f2bea) is red, which fails the aggregate `lint` gate. The 16 KB log tail stops at the expected `##[error][lint_pr_body_auto_close]` fixture lines from the passing `tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py` step, so the failing step cannot be identified from it.
  WHY: The PR cannot merge while this required check is red, and four autofix rounds read only the anchored tail. The two reviewers disagree on severity and cause. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it MAJOR and says the failing step is unidentified; the PR-touched steps at lines 774, 1044 and 1051 show no PR cause. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it BLOCKER. It argues for a job-level kill at the 20-minute timeout (timeout-minutes: 20 at ci.yml:548), because the log ends at a passing step and the next step (ci.yml:837) never starts. The highest severity is used here. Both ask the editor to read the full log of job 130844748366 past the fixture lines and not change code blindly.
- tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py:(no line given) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push test gate reports that tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py still fails after the last autofix run.
  WHY: The reviewer says the logic or the test expectations for `_PLAN_LISTING_DECORATION_RE` and how it interacts with `extract_plan_file_path_sets` remain incorrectly mapped, so the implementation never reaches a verified state.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2387-2390 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate reports `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py` (step "Implement files_touched scope guard unit tests") as failing, and the check-run log does not identify the failing assertion.
  WHY: A non-zero test result blocks the CI gate, so the failure needs investigation before the change counts as verified. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes this: it says tests-release-and-log-analysis, which runs this file at ci.yml:2390, is green, so the pre-push attribution is a sandbox artifact.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:978-979, 1059-1077 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The listing parser accepts a leading table pipe as decoration but does not accept a pipe between listed spans as a joiner. In a row like "| `bin/deploy` | `newdir/tool` |", the second span is classed as prose.
  WHY: The second path is then neither granted nor recorded as ungrantable, so the pipeline can approve a grant that silently omits a listed file and implementation hits the scope guard. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same `_PLAN_LISTING_JOINER_RE` gap only as a HARDENING_SUGGESTION (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:(no line given; added `CHECK_TRIAGE_TRANSIENT_RERUN_ENABLED` variable) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new `transient-rerun` stage runs `scripts/check_failure_triage.sh` and conditionally POSTs to the GitHub Actions API with `secrets.GH_PAT`, which widens the privileged execution scope.
  WHY: A misconfigured or vulnerable rerun path could cause unintended workflow runs, extra resource use, or abuse of the `GH_PAT` scope if the gating is bypassed. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disagrees and considers the step properly gated: continue-on-error, credentials stripped from the classify helper, POST body never printed, and only HTTP 201 counted.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "NEVER use auto-close keywords (`close`, `closes`, `closed`, `fix`, `fixes`, `fixed`, `resolve`, `resolves`, `resolved`, case-insensitive) followed by a reference to an `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue in a PR body." (CLAUDE.md §19, §21)
  expected_change_site: PR description / PR body line 1 ("Automated implementation. Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/9130")
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description contains "Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/9130"; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite calls #9130 an orchestrator tracking issue (BLOCKER). minimax_minimax-m3 (BLOCKER) says it cannot verify the #9130 label, notes the linked issue body does not carry `ai:orchestrator-tracking`, and links the red `lint` aggregate to the `##[error][lint_pr_body_auto_close]` fixture output against #2734 in check-run 130844748366. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not flag it because nothing shows #9130 carries `ai:orchestrator-tracking`.
- requirement: "The pipeline-grant proposal then holds with a new reason `plan_path_not_grantable` and `replannable: true` whenever that list is non-empty" (Goal: "A pipeline plan grant never drops an exact file the approved plan lists … it gets one re-plan")
  expected_change_site: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py `run_plan_auto_approval_gate` (lines 1286-1321) and `_plan_hold_replannable`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The gate sets `plan_path_not_grantable` only when the proposed or counterfactual grant would approve (lines 1297-1310). tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py:2328-2337 / 2333-2337 asserts that the plan `- `scripts/`\n- `bin/deploy`` (ungrantable `["bin/deploy"]`) holds with `path_not_granted`, `denied_paths == ["scripts/"]` and no `replannable` key. The poller (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19587 requires `gate_replannable == "true"`) therefore never re-plans it and it waits for a human. The two reviewers disagree on severity: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT and "not a regression"; openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not re-flag it, calling the held outcome correct.
- requirement: "pass `--planning-root` only when the poller workspace is a checkout of the issue's planning ref. Otherwise pass nothing" (issue Part 2 / Approach step 4)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `_plan_auto_approval_gate`
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The `_plan_auto_approval_gate` invocation of `files_touched_scope_guard.py --plan-auto-approval-gate` passes no `--planning-root`. The poller diff only updates the `gate_replan_cause` / `gate_replan_tg` re-plan branching (around lines 19617–19669), and the comment at lines 19402–19412 states "The poller passes no `--planning-root`". No hunk detects a planning-ref workspace. Severity is NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash did not re-flag it, citing the issue's "Otherwise pass nothing" fallback.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  WHY: The PR cannot merge while this required job is red. The editor needs the full log of job 130844748366, read past the lint-fixture `##[error]` lines (after ci.yml step 806-813), to find the first non-zero step, and should not change code blindly.
- ERROR PATHS: NONE. The reviewer verified that `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py` line 978 `_PLAN_LISTING_DECORATION_RE` has no ambiguous backtracking, link and prose cases are handled, and tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py:2333-2347 match lines 1286-1321 and `_plan_hold_replannable`.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The pipeline-grant proposal then holds with a new reason `plan_path_not_grantable` and `replannable: true` whenever that list is non-empty" (Goal: one re-plan, never drop an exact file) | Expected change site: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py `run_plan_auto_approval_gate` (lines 1286-1321) and `_plan_hold_replannable` | Evidence of absence: tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py:2333-2337 asserts that `- `scripts/`\n- `bin/deploy`` (ungrantable `["bin/deploy"]`) holds with `path_not_granted`, `denied_paths == ["scripts/"]` and no `replannable`. The poller (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19587 requires `gate_replannable == "true"`) never re-plans it. The reviewer records this as a literal departure from the issue wording, not a regression. | SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Not re-flagged: the poller's conditional `--planning-root` (the issue allows "Otherwise pass nothing"); the "Closes #9130" keyword (no evidence #9130 carries `ai:orchestrator-tracking`).
- HARDENING: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py `_PLAN_LISTING_JOINER_RE` (line 979), used in `extract_plan_file_path_sets` (around lines 1054-1062). The table row `| `bin/deploy` | `public/CNAME` |` classes the second span as prose, which silently drops it when there is no planning root. Fix: when the line starts with `|`, use a table-only joiner `^(?:[\s,;&+*_|]|\band\b|\bor\b)*$` and add a test row expecting `["bin/deploy", "public/CNAME"]`. Estimated 4 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
